routes.name: Entry visa (tourist, entrepreneur, work)
routes.summary: Most foreigners apply for a visa at an Equatorial Guinea embassy before traveling. The Berlin embassy lists tourist, entrepreneur and work visas.

other: Entrepreneur: minimum capital of 10,000,000 F.CFA (about 15,000 EUR) per the Berlin embassy.
Worker: bank account at a national financial institution.
Invitation letter legalized by the Ministry of National Security, not needed for tourists.
Visa-free list, validity and e-visa not confirmed. Check the embassy for your passport.

routes.processing: Berlin embassy says about 2 to 5 working days with a complete file. Apply at least 15 days before travel.
